Yotsuba Framework running Vulkan on Android
Yotsuba Framework brings Android into the same modern graphics architecture through Vulkan.

Android Vulkan provides a direct route to the graphics hardware while keeping the XNA-shaped API and MonoGame-oriented development model familiar. This gives mobile projects a focused backend for current Android devices and their GPU workloads.
